verdict.rationale: Docs confirm connector-style integrations for cloud drives (Google Drive, SharePoint) via Plugins/Actions and email-triggered automations (Gmail events for scheduled tasks), showing the assistant can access and act on these sources. However, no evidence explicitly covers calendar integration, and the connector story is fragmented across plugins/actions/automations docs rather than a single unified 'connect your drive+email+calendar' flow. missing for 10: explicit calendar connector documentation, unified connectors settings/search UI evidence, independent hands-on confirmation of drive/email search-in-answers working end to end.
